description: Token security and honeypot check with risk grade A to F for a token before buying or accepting it, on Solana (SPL and Token-2022) and on Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum or Polygon, computed by us directly on the blockchain. Returns a verdict (low, medium, high, critical, or incomplete if the trade simulation could not run), a one-sentence summary ready to show a user, and concrete flags. EVM: buy and sell simulation in the largest pool, including Uniswap v4 pools with hooks (Clanker, Zora and other launchpads) (honeypot, buy and sell tax), owner powers found in the contract code (mint, blacklist, pause, change tax or limits), upgradeable proxy, SELFDESTRUCT, owner share of supply, burned LP, imitation of major token symbols. Solana: freeze authority (the Solana honeypot pattern), mint authority, permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee, non-transferable, frozen default state, mutable metadata, pump.fun bonding curve, top holder share when available. Both: pool liquidity on the major DEXes, token age and price. Params: token (EVM contract address or Solana mint, required), chain (base default, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon; a base58 mint is detected as Solana automatically). Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed","chain":"base"}.
